g.text: One warmup and seven scored rounds per arm, shuffled within setting. Each timed run verified exact recovery.
Combined MB/s = original bytes / median paired (encode seconds + decode seconds) / 1,000,000. Archive time includes creation and full restore.
Experimental options were enabled for eligible inputs. Measurements use a shared host. T1/T4 are requested threads. The second main control is retained in score.csv.
